registered: 2026-10-08, before the vapour-chamber sweep and the parameter search are computed
authority: owner 2026-10-08 ('I approve the cooling plate changes and want a design around what we can show is valuable'), relayed by the Test Lead; existing linear model (lid-spreading.json method) and existing cell solves only, plus lid conduction runs; no new CFD; the 53-job panel stays on hold; thresholds are the Test Lead's working values, final parameters are the owner's

fixed.limit: 85 C at the lid-side TIM2 interface
fixed.hotspot: raw ratio 3, width 2.5 mm, centres 15 and 24 mm
fixed.designs: the 32 existing cell designs; a design whose existing solve left the PG25 range stays UNRESOLVED in that stratum (no new solve)

step1: post-spreader peak/mean per band for an isotropic effective lid k in {2000, 3000, 4000, 5000} W/mK at t 1.5, 2.0 and 3.0 mm (copper 391 for reference), nominal R2'' and the median cell conductance

search_grid.fixed_strata: cold inlet 30 C; typical 1000 W at inlet min(40, warm inlet)

prediction: as lid-spreading.json step 2: face rise above inlet from the design's warm solves, scaled by power; hotspot strata add the post-spreader departure through the design's own raw-hotspot response; interface = face + R2'' q_b. Inlet shifts the whole field (property change with temperature neglected and stated)

criteria_per_stratum.classes: PASS margin >= +2 K, FAIL <= -2 K, NEAR between; resolved = PASS + NEAR + FAIL
criteria_per_stratum.b_spread: max - min margin over resolved designs >= 5 K

criteria_global.c_feasibility: at least one design is PASS in all five strata
criteria_global.d_answer_change: the best design (packet objective: lowest hydraulic power among PASS designs, ties by margin; hydraulic power = cell dp x flow scaled by power^2) differs in at least two strata; the best-by-margin is also reported

report: every grid point's per-criterion values; the candidates meeting (a)-(d) in every stratum; if none, the failing criterion and its shortfall for the closest points; 2-3 candidates with a realism note and one recommendation (owner decides)
